description: Defines the structural behavior and cognitive architecture of the Silvertongue actor.

identity.mechanism: Core values are injected into the system prompt to define the agent's character and ensure consistent behavior across all interactions.

workflow.description: Incoming content is evaluated to determine its specific domain (e.g., Chemistry, Politics).
workflow.guidance: Uses accumulated 'experiences' from actor/expertise/domain/experience/experiences.yaml to guide classification.

workflow.description: A dynamic system prompt is constructed for the specific interaction.

composition.role: Sets the ethical and behavioral baseline.
Focuses the agent's attention on the relevant field.
Applies past learnings and decision patterns relevant to the domain.

workflow.description: The agent generates a response or analysis based on the synthesized dynamic prompt.

principal.purpose: Stores fundamental principles for understanding the world.

adjustment.purpose: Defines rules for processing specific domains.

core.purpose: Stores immutable facts and natural/social laws.

supporting.purpose: Stores case studies and contextual facts.

experience.purpose: Stores distilled actions and heuristics for decision making.

challenge.purpose: Stores anomalies and facts that contradict existing principles/experiences for future resolution.
